sources.title: BigBang — Pursuing Open-Ended Intelligence through Self-Evolving ...
sources.snippet: BigBang is a general-purpose large language model evolved from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B through efficient post-training, driven by an adversarial, self-evolving synthetic data framework grounded in verifiable frontier research tasks. BigBang reaches aggregate performance between DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) and DeepSeek V4 Pro (1.6T).

sources.title: BigBang-v1/README.md at main · endless-frontier/BigBang-v1
sources.snippet: BigBang-v1 is a 35B-A3B agentic model built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, with 35B total parameters and 3B parameters activated during inference. We evaluate it on long-horizon search, coding, scientific research, and AI research.

sources.title: China's Endless Frontier Team Releases BigBang-V1, First Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: The Endless Frontier team, a China-based academic-industry collaboration, released BigBang-V1, which it calls the first foundation model trained natively with recursive self-improving; its post-training data is 100% AI-synthesized.
